editorial.blurb: A warm, bustling Greek taverna where expertly grilled seafood and theatrical flaming cheese create memorable meals alongside genuinely attentive service.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for Yannis when you book—he delivers stellar wine pairings and recommendations—and don't miss the flaming cheese (saganaki), which is both a delicious dish and a fun table moment that appears on plates around the room.
signatureDishes: Crispy eggplant with tomato sauce and cheese
